title: 🧩 Combined projects
text:
Here is the result of "fetch" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/401f89e5e0fc81c787f4cf27dc5cb151 as of 2026-10-22T06:07:44.174Z: {"title":"Combined projects"} {"type":"emoji","emoji":"🧩"} Three writing projects that combine chapters 1–8. Each project has two writing tasks and one warm-up drill, so every grammar guide gets used in a realistic text. ## How it works Pick a project
Start with the one closest to the chapters you want to revise. Do the exercises in order
Each page has the task, words, a grammar checklist, a plan, a writing box and a self-check. Compare with the model
Open the toggle at the end only after you have written your own text. ## Choose a project Project A: We've moved Project B: A day out that went wrong Project C: Booking a weekend at the coast ## At a glance | Project | Chapters | You will write | Time | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A: We've moved | 4, 5, 8 | A comparison message and a room description | 45 min | | B: A day out that went wrong | 1, 2, 7 | A city trip message and a lost-property form | 45 min | | C: Booking a weekend at the coast | 3, 6 (plus 2, 4 vocab) | A hotel email and a booking change | 45 min | ## Where each grammar topic appears | Grammar topic | A | B | C | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Adjective endings | Main focus | Main focus | Light | | Er is/zijn, geen/niet | Main focus | Light | Light | | Comparisons | Main focus | – | – | | Perfect tense | – | Main focus | Light | | Eerst, dan, daarna, gaan with an infinitive | – | Main focus | Light | | Mogen, moeten | – | – | Main focus | | Omdat, zal | – | – | Main focus | | Want, en, maar, of | Main focus | – | Light | | Writing checklist | Yes | Yes | Yes | --- Back to Dutch study
